Chansey

Normal

Kanto · Generation 1

Chansey is a Normal-type Egg Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 1.1 m tall and weighs 34.6 kg. It evolves from Happiny and into Blissey. Its highest base stat is HP (250), with a base stat total of 450.
